name: Release Keeper
summary: Shows the current release, past releases with notes and verification, daily reports and lessons, and emails the daily report.
description: Keeps one place for releases, verification state, daily reports (Morning and End of day) and lessons learned. Syncs from GitHub and server health endpoints every 15 minutes, saves reports and verification history in its own SQLite database, and emails the daily report to the owner.

application.description: Shows releases, daily reports and lessons, and emails the daily report.

arguments: python -m py_compile main.py store.py github_sync.py report.py && mkdir -p dist/ui && cp main.py store.py github_sync.py report.py dist/ && cp ui/app.css ui/app.js ui/page.css ui/page.js ui/index.html dist/ui/

settings.name: RK_BOARD_NUMBER
settings.description: GitHub Project board number for pipeline and Verify column

settings.name: RK_BOARD_OWNER
settings.description: GitHub user or org that owns the Project board

settings.name: RK_PROD_API_URL
settings.description: Production Automaton server API URL (for health/version check)

settings.name: RK_TEST_API_URL
settings.description: Test Automaton server API URL (for health/version check)

settings.name: EMAIL_TO
settings.description: Who gets daily report emails (needs notify:email): owner, administrators, project or an allowed address

secrets.name: RK_GH_TOKEN
secrets.description: Read-only GitHub token (repo, project scopes) used to sync releases, board 17, PRs, runs and lessons

schedules.name: Sync
schedules.description: Sync releases, Verify column, lessons and server versions from GitHub and health endpoints

schedules.name: Daily report (Morning)
schedules.description: Generate and email the Morning daily report

schedules.name: Daily report (End of day)
schedules.description: Generate and email the End of day report
